works.body:
たまらさん、こんにちは！イラストをお願いしたいです！個人的な使用のみです。
リンク先のキャラクターはオリジナルキャラです。ほとんどの情報は写真に載っています。外国人なので、用語が間違っていたらすみません。服装、ポーズ、表情など、お好きなように描いてください！
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ubJrc12Cwa4dR2gwqWXiuDpGOl3yH-JF?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ubJrc12Cwa4dR2gwqWXiuDpGOl3yH-JF?usp=sharing

Thank you for your help,
Good evening, Tamara-san,
I have an illustration request for you this time, if you don't mind.

Please refer to the following site for the appearance of the character
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mtiE4aHZypxDApzHdviCIkHR6cbas92k/view?usp=sharing
A beautiful boy with white hair. Eyes should be yellowish.
A little more cute than cool.

Clothes can be a little less cloth.
I'll leave the basic situation to Tamara.

I have two requests for color illustrations
A little sexy devilish boy
This is what I was thinking of.
https://x.com/yamasodachi55/status/1862242376577949857

I like cute boys, so I would be happy if the composition is such that you can see that.

If you can provide a transparent background and unintegrated PSD file of the character, please do.
I will use it for my own wallpaper, icons, personal printing, etc.
I plan to use the illustration on Twitter.
I may use them as materials for requests to other people.
I will always annotate the teacher before publishing.
We would very much appreciate your consideration!

Hello, I saw your lovely illustration of my character in X!
I saw Tamara㌠s very cute and wonderful illustrations on X and I really wanted to request you to draw my character as well!
I especially love your illustration of Nugumaki-kun, and when I saw it, it touched my heart!
The details of the character I would like you to draw for me are as follows

Character Information
Gender: Boy
Eyes: Red right eye and light blue left eye
Hair: Light blue
Other decorations
Three earrings on each earlobe
Light blue and red hairpin on the left side of his hair
A mole under her left eye
Light pigmentation overall
Personality
Mocking, whimsical, friendly

I love Tamara㌠s art style so much that I would like to leave everything to her, including the composition and facial expressions!
I am also open to changes in hairstyles and outfits!

I would like to use your illustration as a standby for my iPad, so I would like it to be a horizontal illustration of about 4:3!

If this request is difficult or you are not willing to do so, please do not hesitate to resend the amount or cancel the order!
I know you are busy, but please consider this request 🤲.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-GTpLik2VrU1v65LGBxs-5DISi2IRdus

Hello! I love Tamara's illustrations and I always enjoy looking at her wonderful pictures! I would like to commission an illustration from you!
This is my first time to request skeb, so I apologize if I don't have enough information.

Details of the request
I would like to have two beautiful neutral boys dressed in jersey maid outfits. The clothes should be light blue, white, and black.

I would like to use the picture I commissioned from Tamara as a keepsake.

Boy (1)
A beautiful boy with wolf hair, black hair, and blue eyes. He is more cool than cute. He should have about 3 piercings in his ears (either one or the other is fine, even if one eye is not hidden by his bangs!)

Boy ②.
Neutral, beautiful boy with mashed hair, grayish hair, and wavy eyelashes. I prefer light blue eyes. He is more cute than cool, sleepy and slow-paced.

I would like the motif to be angelic, but with a slightly dark, light-hearted atmosphere.
I would like to leave the pose and composition to Tamara! I would be happy if you could draw the image as you see fit!

If there are any difficulties with the request, please decline. I would appreciate your consideration.

Nice to meet you. I admire your work! Please draw 2 characters who are from fantasy Japan.

Chara A. Calligrapher. From a noble family. Naive. Can be selfish. His eyes are always twinkling.

Chara B. Servant. Hard worker. Cautious. Unlucky. He always looks tired.

The two are childhood friends. Chara A depends a lot on Chara B.

I will leave the rest to you. Thank you! 

Reference 👇

https://sta.sh/21pwcwzeznb3

Dear Tamara, it is nice to meet you! This is my first time to make a request. I enjoyed looking at your beautiful drawings! I am attracted by your beautiful drawings and would like to commission Tamara to illustrate my own character if it is possible.

[Details of the request
Please see the following URL for references to the character and her attire. They are two senior and junior members of an elf tribe serving at a shrine in a Japanese-style fantasy setting. We have known each other for a long time, so we are very close now.

[1]
Junior (short-haired girl, 177cm). She has a kind and calm personality on the outside, but inside she is a bit tsundere and a bit cocky. She is a caring person. Her right eye is brown and her left eye is blue.

2]
Senpai (pony-tailed girl, 180cm). He is cool and quiet on the front and shy on the back. He is kind of a pain in the ass because he is always being taken care of by others. Please wear ear ornaments only on the left ear.

If possible, please draw a single illustration with the motif of "hydrangea" between the two of them. We would be very happy if you could draw them in a calm atmosphere. We would like to leave the other poses and composition to Tamara, so please feel free to draw them!

If there are any difficulties or problems with the request, please feel free to decline.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zme8Lu3By7Ay44m-CSSQKymAQRRT0M-a?usp=sharing
